_comment: Official RavaLink egg for Pterodactyl and Pelican. Tracks the latest published GitHub Release at startup.
name: RavaLink
author: Ravalink-Project
description: Native Rust Lavalink-compatible audio node. Downloads and runs the latest published RavaLink GitHub Release on startup.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ravalink-Project/Ravalink-eggs/main/scripts/start.sh" --output /mnt/server/start.sh
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "RavaLink startup bootstrap installed."
echo "The latest published release is resolved at each server start."

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: The primary allocation port used by the RavaLink HTTP and WebSocket server.

variables.name: Server Address
variables.description: Bind address. Keep this at 0.0.0.0 inside the container.

variables.name: Node Password
variables.description: Set a unique random secret of at least 16 characters before starting the server.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Tracing filter: trace, debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Player Update Interval
variables.description: Player state update interval in seconds.

variables.name: Resampling Quality
variables.description: Audio resampling quality: low, medium or high.

variables.name: Maximum Source Download Bytes
variables.description: Maximum compressed source size accepted by the direct-file resolver.

variables.name: Maximum Decoded Cache Bytes
variables.description: Maximum decoded PCM retained in the pending loadtracks cache.

variables.name: Maximum Active Decoded PCM Bytes
variables.description: Maximum decoded PCM held by active native players.

variables.name: Prometheus Metrics Enabled
variables.description: Expose the configured Prometheus metrics endpoint.

variables.name: Prometheus Metrics Endpoint
variables.description: Absolute HTTP path for Prometheus metrics.
